situation: Trying to plan a reunion dinner for 8 college friends in our group chat. Every time someone asks 'when works for everyone' it dies. I want to actually get it booked.
reply: Okay, making this real: dinner at Pho Saigon on Friday 24 October, 7:30. 👍 if you're in, 👎 if you can't, by Sunday night please so I can book. If I don't hear from you I'll count you in, so speak up if not!
note: Propose one plan, ask for a one-tap reply, set a deadline and say what happens by default.

situation: 我们家族群要定今年春节去谁家过，已经讨论了三天，大姑家和二舅家两边都有人支持，吵来吵去定不下来。我是小辈，想推动一下。
reply: 各位长辈，我来汇总一下：目前是两个选项，大姑家（年三十吃年夜饭）或者二舅家（初一中午聚）。大家在自己支持的那个后面回个1或者2就行，周五晚上8点前统计，按多数定。定下来以后具体安排我再单独跟那边对接。
note: 两个选项、一键回复、截止时间和默认规则。小辈只做汇总和推进，不替长辈拍板。

situation: I booked the lake house for our friend group's weekend (the 17th to 19th) after the deadline passed. Now Chris is complaining in the chat that he wanted the 24th and nobody asked him properly.
reply: Fair, Chris, the 24th would have been easier for you and I'm sorry it didn't work out. It's booked and paid now, so the 17th stands. You get first pick on the dates for the ski trip in January.
note: Acknowledge, hold the decision, hand him the next one. Don't reopen it in the group.

situation: Organicé el regalo de jubilación de Carmen en el grupo de WhatsApp de la oficina: 15 euros cada uno, somos 12. Ya compré la bici de paseo (180 euros) y todavía faltan 4 por pagar. La fiesta es el viernes 9 de octubre.
reply: ¡La bici de Carmen ya está comprada y bien escondida! 🚲 Gracias a los que ya habéis pagado. Faltan 4 aportaciones de 15 euros: por Bizum al 612 345 678 o en mano en mi mesa. Si podéis antes del miércoles 7, cierro las cuentas antes de la fiesta del viernes. Pulgar arriba cuando esté hecho y os tacho de la lista.
note: Cobrar en el grupo sin señalar a nadie: importe, cómo pagar, fecha límite y una reacción de un toque. A quien siga sin pagar el miércoles, mensaje privado.

situation: I run a monthly board game night with 6 friends. Ollie has said yes and then bailed on the day for the last three. It's messing up the numbers for 4-player games. I want to message him privately, not call him out in the group.
reply: Hey Ollie, not a big deal, but you've dropped out on the day for the last three game nights and I've started planning the tables around you not coming. If things are hard right now, tell me and I'll stop pestering. If game night just isn't your thing at the moment, that's fine too, I'd rather know. Want me to count you in for Friday 23 October, or sit this one out?
note: A pattern with one person goes to a private message with a real out, never a callout in the group.

situation: I'm in a WhatsApp group with 5 other parents for the soccer practice carpool, Tuesdays and Thursdays at 5:30. Every week it's chaos over who drives. I want to lock in a rota for October.
reply: Proposal so we stop sorting it week by week. October drivers: Tue 6 Anna, Thu 8 me, Tue 13 Raj, Thu 15 Kemi, Tue 20 Luis, Thu 22 Dana, then Tue 27 Anna and Thu 29 me. Thumbs up if your date works, or reply with a swap by Thursday evening. If nobody objects by then, this is the rota, and any later swaps happen directly between the two drivers.
note: Post a complete draft instead of asking who can drive; the default kicks in if people stay quiet.
